children: LeonaBio announced 23,031,494 warrants became exercisable with potential proceeds of about $146.2 million if fully cash‑exercised.
Issued 23,031,494 Series A Common Warrants in Dec 2025 with $6.35 exercise price.
Warrants became exercisable on Sept 18, 2026 and expire Oct 19, 2026.
If exercised in cash in full, warrants would provide approximately $146.2 million of capital.
Company warns proceeds may be reduced if warrants expire unexercised or are cashed out via cashless exercise.
